source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Whenever this weapon hits a unit with the **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** keyword, if the bearer declares a charge against that unit later in the turn, the bearer gets +2 to its [Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step) and enemy units cannot shoot at it with the **[Fire Overwatch](vsdata:core-rule/fire-overwatch)** Stratagem.

detail.condition: bearer declares a charge against that unit
